messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: CRITICAL — /api/v1/generate 5xx error rate spike >5% (1m) in us-west1. Trigger: gateway-5xx-rate > threshold. PD: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/P12345 :rotating_light:
oncall-Alex: Acked and on it. Jumping into logs and router metrics.
Priya (SRE): Thanks — can you confirm whether this is all 502s or mixed 5xx? Any correlated deploys?
oncall-Alex: Mostly 502/504. Spike started ~02:03 UTC. No deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot.
Jordan (Runtime): Seeing increased connection resets at the inference-gateway sidecar layer, plus a bunch of upstream timeouts from kv-cache proxies. snippet from logs:
```
2026-03-17T02:03:12Z gateway-frontend error: upstream response 502 read ETIMEDOUT id=xyz
2026-03-17T02:03:13Z kvcache proxy WARN: connection reset by peer
```
Priya (SRE): Good data. Initial mitigation plan: 1) Remove gateway weight from us-west1 for non-critical routes (shift to eu-west1 fallback), 2) Temporarily increase kvcache pool size and reduce keepalive timeout, 3) Disable canary routing for inference-v2. I can run the k8s scale quickly if Alex approves.
oncall-Alex: Approved. Running commands now: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment kvcache --replicas=6 --context=us-west1` and patching gateway weights.
Maya (Support): Heads-up — support reports ~25 customer tickets with 5xx traces (mostly batch ingestion endpoints). I've queued an initial status note to affected customers citing elevated errors and active mitigation. Cleo, want me to publish a status page incident?
Cleo (PM): Yes please — publish "Elevated 5xx error rates for API in us-west1, mitigation in progress" and link to ticket. Mark as 'degraded' not 'major outage' until we have confirmed impact.
Jordan (Runtime): Rolled back canary routing for inference-v2 in us-west1 to v1 (policy: immediate). Observed request success rate climb from 88% -> 95% over next 45s for routed traffic.
Priya (SRE): kvcache replicas up and keepalive reduced to 60s. Also bumped nginx upstream open file limits on gateway pods. Monitoring dashboards show the error rate halving.
oncall-Alex: Running a second wave of traffic checks and tailing envoy metrics. So far error rate down to ~1.2% over 1m window.
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert auto-resolved (P12345) — alert condition cleared.
Maya (Support): Updating customer tickets: "We've implemented a rollback and routing changes; error rates are back to normal. We'll follow up with a root cause update."
Cleo (PM): Good work. Can we schedule a post-incident sync at 10:30 UTC for RCA owners? Priya, Jordan, Alex please own the action items: root cause, long-term kvcache sizing, and better canary safeguards.
Priya (SRE): Yep — I’ll own kvcache sizing and short-term hotfix to keep headroom.
Jordan (Runtime): I’ll run a canary policy audit and add an auto-fallback rule if upstream timeouts spike.
oncall-Alex: Wrapping up logs and creating the incident timeline. Marking thread for postmortem. All clear from oncall side — handoff to daytime SRE.
Cleo (PM): Thanks team — closing handoff. :white_check_mark:
